lines.trans: Hi, Timur, how are you doing this morning?
Hi, gorgeous, do you know who blocked my driveway?
No, we saw that insolent car ourselves this morning.
Because of him I have to walk an extra twenty meters on foot!
Timur, tell me, do you have any rotten eggs?
Are you offending me, gorgeous? Of course I do not!
What a pity, otherwise we would punish him for his parking!

words.gloss: it is a pity, too bad

lines.trans: Oh, for a cause like that? Then of course I have some!
Here you go, the very best choice rotten eggs!
Great, come on and keep me company right now!
With great pleasure, let's throw them right at the windshield!
Now that owner will definitely learn how to park properly!
